_about: Forms case managers complete, gather, or give to the person. Edit freely: change descriptions, add forms, or set "cm": false to hide one from the case manager view. 'more' is a CBSM page ID for background. Sources: CBSM Forms (ID_000688), CBSM Documents for LTSS assessment, eligibility and support planning (ID_002207), and Ramsey County ADS bulletins.

forms.title: MnCHOICES Reassessment Communication Form
forms.desc: Your referral to the county of residence asking for a reassessment. Include the type of assessment, attached documents, current program, guardian, scheduling contact and your contact information. Ramsey County asks case managers to send it between the 120th and 150th day before the service agreement ends, include their NPI number, and use the county's email subject-line format.

forms.title: Instructions for the MnCHOICES Reassessment Communication Form
forms.desc: Line-by-line instructions for filling out DHS-6791E.

forms.title: 65th Birthday Checklist
forms.desc: Attach to the DHS-6791E when requesting a 65th birthday assessment. Ramsey County's September 2026 bulletin notes DHS changed the 65th birthday assessment process as of 8/1/26.

forms.title: MnCHOICES Primary Medical Provider's Documentation of Medical Monitoring and Treatment Needs
forms.desc: Completed by the person's primary medical provider to document medical monitoring and treatment needs for CAC. Ramsey County asks that CAC reassessment referrals include it; it's attached to the person's record in MnCHOICES when applicable.

forms.title: Related Conditions Checklist
forms.desc: Documents a related condition for DD eligibility. Used with MnCHOICES for DD when applicable and attached to the person record. See the instructions, DHS-3848A.

forms.title: MnCHOICES Coordinated Services and Supports Plan Signature Sheet
forms.desc: The person signs to confirm they took part in developing their plan, were given choices, and received privacy and appeal-rights information. It also has a section for Rule 185 DD case management recipients who choose to waive their annual MnCHOICES reassessment.

forms.title: Individual Community Living Support (ICLS) Planning Form
forms.desc: Planning form for ICLS services, completed by the case manager or care coordinator and attached to the person record in MnCHOICES.

forms.title: My Move Plan Summary
forms.desc: Developed with the person when they are moving, when required, to summarize the plan for the move.

forms.title: I Know Me: Creating the Best Home for Me
forms.desc: Person-centered tool used with the person to explore what matters to them in a home, as applicable.

forms.title: HCBS Rights Modification Support Plan Attachment
forms.desc: Attachment to the person's support plan that documents any modification of their HCBS rights, such as a restriction in a 245D-licensed service, and the reason for it.

forms.title: CDCS Community Support Plan
forms.desc: The person's CDCS plan. The case manager reviews and approves it. See also DHS-6633 for budget exceptions.

forms.title: Monitoring Technology Approval Request (DHS-6789A, B and C)
forms.desc: The approval request process for using monitoring technology in a person's services. DHS-6789 lists the three forms in the process.

forms.title: Lead Agency Addendum to CFSS Individual Service Delivery Plan
forms.desc: Completed and signed by the lead agency after it approves the person's CFSS service delivery plan (DHS-6893P). It tells the person the plan's start and end dates, which match the service agreement, and the final approved units or dollar amounts. Upload it with the DHS-6893P to MnCHOICES, send copies to the person, their CFSS provider agency and/or FMS provider, and adjust the service agreement to match if needed. Case management aides can't approve the plan.

forms.title: CFSS Individual Service Delivery Plan
forms.desc: The person's CFSS plan, developed with their consultation services provider. The lead agency reviews it to make sure it meets requirements and includes only covered goods and services, then approves it with the DHS-6893W. For someone on a waiver or AC, confirm the changes fit within their CDCS and/or AC/EW budget.

forms.title: Temporary CFSS Individual Service Delivery Plan Approval
forms.desc: Used to avoid a gap in services when a new CFSS service delivery plan isn't approved by the end of the current authorization. Send it to the person and all of their CFSS providers.

forms.title: CFSS Assessment for 45-Day Increase
forms.desc: Used by the lead agency to complete assessments for a 45-day temporary increase in PCA/CFSS services.

forms.title: LTC: Communication of LTSS Eligibility Form
forms.programs: All waivers, AC, nursing facility admits
forms.desc: The form case managers and county financial workers use to communicate about a person's long-term care eligibility (for example, when waiver services open, change or close, or before a nursing facility admission).

forms.title: AC Program Eligibility Worksheet
forms.desc: Worksheet for determining financial eligibility for Alternative Care. Attached in MnCHOICES. DHS-2630A is the Type A version.

forms.title: Essential Community Supports (ECS) Financial Eligibility Worksheet
forms.desc: Worksheet for determining financial eligibility for ECS. Attached in MnCHOICES. DHS-6683A covers a married person when only one spouse requests services.

forms.title: Application for Social Services
forms.desc: Used (or a lead-agency-developed equivalent) to apply for Rule 185 case management.

forms.title: LTSS Notice of Action (Assessments and Reassessments)
forms.desc: Written notice about an assessment or reassessment decision, including the person's appeal rights. Check CBSM - Notice of action for when it's required.

forms.title: LTSS Notice of Action – Explanation of Changes to Your Support Plan
forms.desc: Written notice when services in the plan are denied, reduced, suspended or terminated, including appeal rights. Attached in MnCHOICES. Check CBSM - Notice of action for when it's required.

forms.title: Your Appeal Rights
forms.desc: Explains how to appeal. Given with notices of action (or a lead-agency-developed equivalent).

forms.title: Appeal to State Agency
forms.desc: Form a person can use to file an appeal with DHS.

forms.title: EW Conversion Rate Request
forms.desc: Request for an EW conversion rate, as applicable. Attached in MnCHOICES.

forms.title: AC/EW PCA/CFSS Enhanced Rate Budget Exception Request
forms.desc: Request for a budget exception tied to the PCA/CFSS enhanced rate, as applicable. Attached in MnCHOICES.

forms.title: Caregiver Living Expenses Worksheet
forms.desc: Worksheet for the caregiver living expenses service.

forms.title: Additional Square Footage Approval Request
forms.desc: Approval request for environmental accessibility adaptations that add square footage.

forms.title: Disability Waiver Rates System Exception Request
forms.desc: Request for an exception to a rate calculated by the Disability Waiver Rate System (DWRS). Instructions are in DHS-5820A.

forms.title: Exception to CDCS Budget Methodology
forms.desc: Request for an exception to the standard CDCS budget methodology.

forms.title: Exception Request for Environmental Accessibility Adaptations that Exceed $40,000
forms.desc: Exception request when environmental accessibility adaptations (home or vehicle modifications) will cost more than $40,000. Use the checklist, DHS-5504C, with it.

forms.title: Remote Support Exception Form
forms.desc: Exception request related to remote support. DHS publishes this one as an online form rather than a PDF.

forms.title: Customized Living Size-Limit Exception Request Form
forms.desc: Exception request related to the size limit for customized living settings.

forms.title: LTC Screening Document – AC, BI, CAC, CADI, ECS, EW, MHM, MSC+, MSHO, SNBC
forms.programs: AC, BI, CAC, CADI, ECS, EW
forms.desc: Built into MnCHOICES for assessments. Use this form for updates outside of MnCHOICES, such as administrative changes not related to an assessment. Instructions are in DHS-4625.

forms.title: DD Screening Document
forms.desc: Built into MnCHOICES for assessments. Use this form for administrative changes made outside of MnCHOICES.

forms.title: MnCHOICES Lead Agency Transfer and Communication Form
forms.desc: Used to transfer a case or communicate between lead agencies, for example when a person moves to another county.

forms.title: Interagency Case Transfer Form
forms.desc: General form for transferring a case between agencies.

forms.title: Host County Notification of Residential Placement Form
forms.desc: Notifies the host county when a person moves into a residential setting in that county.

forms.title: MCO/County/Tribal Agency Communication Form – Recommendation for State Plan Home Care Services
forms.programs: MSHO, MSC+, SNBC, Families and Children only
forms.desc: Recommendation for state plan home care services for people on those managed care programs.

forms.title: Notice of Privacy Practices and Notice of Rights and Responsibilities
forms.desc: Privacy and rights information given to the person (or a lead-agency-developed equivalent). The CSSP signature sheet asks the person to confirm they received it.

forms.title: Minnesota Abuse Reporting Center Brochure
forms.programs: Required for DD Waiver assessments; others as applicable
forms.desc: Explains how to report suspected maltreatment of a vulnerable adult.

forms.title: About the MnCHOICES documents you are receiving
forms.desc: Explains the MnCHOICES assessment and support plan documents the person receives.

forms.title: AC Program Estate Recovery Information
forms.desc: Explains estate recovery for Alternative Care. Ramsey County's September 2026 bulletin asks lead agencies to share it with people on AC.

forms.title: AC Program Monthly Fee and Payment Information
forms.desc: Explains AC monthly fees and payments. Useful when following up on the AC Overdue Fee Report.

forms.title: Information for People Who Use CFSS
forms.desc: Plain-language information about CFSS for the person and their family.
